conclusion: On these 6 LOCATE tasks, on this repo at cb8f6a8, in ONE run per cell: the bundle did NOT improve correctness and did NOT reduce work. Both arms were exactly right on all six, including both traps. The augmented arm spent 15 tool calls to the baseline's 9, because the graph verb could not license the completeness the question required — so it re-derived the answer with an independent text sweep anyway, paying for both.

the_finding_that_matters: The augmented arm was not wrong; it was UNWARRANTED. graph_whereis computes the population (a COUNT over the same predicate was added on 2026-08-12) but only surfaces it when the result is CAPPED. When nothing is capped it says nothing, so "10 rows" and "10 rows, and that is all of them" are indistinguishable to the reader. That is the same defect class fixed in graph_packet all week — a population known to the code and not stated to the reader — left standing in the sibling verb. Enumerate every emitter, again.
